cleavage_agent: These protein spots were manually cut from the gels, digested in-gel with trypsin (PROMEGA)
instrument: Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
The cleared peptide digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Hemel Hempstead, UK)
labeling: Shotgun proteomics followed by label-free quantification
mass_analyzer: inferred: The cleared peptide digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine was set as a fixed modification and oxidation of methionine as a variable modification.
